from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiability(BaseModel):
    """A single company's financial liability report extracted for the period in question."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    total_liabilities: float | None = Field(description="The total liabilities amount reported (负债合计), numeric value")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the amount (e.g., CNY, Yuan, RMB)")
    report_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report period ended (e.g., 2024-03-31)")
    evidence_text: str | None = Field(description="The specific text excerpt or summary containing the liability figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_liabilities: list[CompanyLiability]
